description: Shared commercial pipeline for Amazon Marketing Service, Fulfillment, Shipping OS, and Anata Intelligence.

stages.label: New Lead
stages.definition: A prospect who has never been in the pipeline before.

stages.label: Contacted
stages.definition: A response has been received back from the new lead.

stages.label: Qualified
stages.definition: The lead has been qualified as a prospect that can be offered a service or software.

stages.label: Audit Or Deck In Progress
stages.definition: The team is preparing the proposal deck and audit.

stages.label: Proposal Ready
stages.definition: The proposal deck and audit have been created and not yet sent.

stages.label: Negotiation
stages.definition: The deck has been reviewed with the client and the opportunity is in discussion.

stages.label: Closed Won
stages.definition: The client was won and is entering onboarding.

stages.label: Closed Lost
stages.definition: The prospect clearly said no and is no longer interested.

stages.label: Nurture
stages.definition: There is no defined no and the opportunity should move into a follow-up track.
